 입력 2026.11.08. 12:10 조선비즈 구글 검색 먼저 보기 
 On the 8th at Daegu Samsung Lions Park, Game 5 of the 2026 Shinhan SOL KBO Korea Series between the Samsung Lions and the KT Wiz was held.
 With Samsung leading the series 3-1 and needing just one more win to clinch the title, KT was on the brink, needing to win all three remaining games to take the championship. For the game, Samsung started Won Tae-in, and KT started Daniel.
 Before the game, Samsung's Díaz is smiling. Nov. 8, 2026
